semantic_fragments.content: The device is not CLASS I ME EQUIPMENT (no protective earth warning required), not supplied with an integral multiple socket-outlet (no MSO warning required), has no separate power supply part requiring specification statement, has no mains-operated additional power source requiring periodic checking warning, and has no SIGNAL INPUT/OUTPUT PART requiring connection restrictions. The device does have primary batteries and replaceable INTERNAL ELECTRICAL POWER SOURCE, with relevant warnings and specifications referenced in the 'Setup and operating procedures' chapter of the operation guide.

The device is intended for use by the PATIENT as an OPERATOR. The operation guide includes: warnings against servicing and maintenance while the ME EQUIPMENT is in use; functions the PATIENT can safely use and which functions the PATIENT cannot safely use; maintenance the PATIENT can perform.

The instructions for use are provided in English as the language acceptable to the intended operator. ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENTS are provided on paper (not electronically on CD ROM), making the electronic document usability engineering requirement N/A.
